title: On WordPress a button keeps its link and class around the new words, and picture uploads the door cannot place are skipped in words
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A WordPress export keeps a slot's single inline wrapper (a button link, a whole-span badge) around the new words when the slot keeps inline markup, and writes every other slot as plain words; the JA Diner WordPress write step sends the first slide's button as ((a class="btn btn-primary" href="/about-us"))Book a table((/a)); the WordPress door answers media.upload itself as not_on_wordpress and never sends it.

tests: a slot whose demo is one inline element around its words keeps it; every other slot is plain words
the wrapper is the one element around all the words, never part of a sentence or a nested one
a WordPress Diner run writes its words as plain text in one apply, and skips in words what the plugin does not take
🔒 on WordPress a call of a Joomla stage or an upload is answered by name and never sent; the contract is sent
